name: TeamStarWolf - APT41 Public Record
description: Curated view of the techniques bound in the TeamStarWolf case study APT41: The Public Record, 2012 to 2026 (case-studies/APT41_PUBLIC_RECORD.md). Not an official MITRE mapping. Score 100: ATT&CK v20.0 records the technique for G0096 APT41 or its attributed campaigns C0017 and C0040. Score 60: a vendor or government primary states the id in its own ATT&CK table (revoked ids normalized through data/attack/superseded_by.jsonl). Score 30: the study's own inference from a dated report. Each comment names the study's source numbers. Campaign C0012 Operation CuckooBees is left out because ATT&CK attributes it to no group.

legendItems.label: 100: recorded by ATT&CK v20.0 for APT41 or its attributed campaigns
60: stated by a vendor or government primary in its own ATT&CK table
30: inferred by the case study from a dated report

metadata.name: selection_rule
metadata.value: Every technique the case study binds: the live ATT&CK G0096 roll-up plus the C0017 and C0040 campaign pages (score 100), ids stated in vendor or government ATT&CK tables (score 60), and the study's labelled inferences (score 30).

metadata.name: score_meaning
metadata.value: 100 = recorded by ATT&CK; 60 = stated by a primary source; 30 = inferred by the case study. No severity, prevalence, confidence, or control coverage is measured.

metadata.name: tactic_policy
metadata.value: Each selected technique is shown under all tactics in data/attack/technique_profiles.jsonl. This is display expansion, not a claim that every source association applies in every tactic.

metadata.name: attack_version
metadata.value: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise v20.0: technique IDs and tactics normalized to data/attack/technique_profiles.jsonl by scripts/build_navigator_layers.py
